data.text:
"Create extract_text.py in the current working directory.
Task: extracts plain text from a scanned document image.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: extract_text.py
+import argparse
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_RESPONSES_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4.1-mini"
+
+
+def extract_text(image_path: str) -> str:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    path = Path(image_path)
+    if not path.is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(image_path)
+
+    mime = "image/png"
+    suffix = path.suffix.lower()
+    if suffix in {".jpg", ".jpeg"}:
+        mime = "image/jpeg"
+    elif suffix == ".webp":
+        mime = "image/webp"
+    elif suffix == ".gif":
+        mime = "image/gif"
+
+    image_b64 = base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode("utf-8")
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": "Extract all readable plain text from this scanned document image. Return only the text."},
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": f"data:{mime};base64,{image_b64}"},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_RESPONSES_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=120,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    texts = []
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                text = content.get("text")
+                if text:
+                    texts.append(text)
+
+    return "\n".join(texts).strip()
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("image_path")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    sys.stdout.write(extract_text(args.image_path))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
